label: 27 November 2026
title: Balde mild ankle sprain, not ruled out of Dépor; Barça will not appeal Fermín ban
deck: Official note confirms Alejandro Balde has a mild right ankle sprain after leaving the Sabah match. He is not ruled out of Sunday at Riazor. The club has decided not to appeal Fermín López’s two-match ban.

stories.headline: Balde has a mild right ankle sprain and is not ruled out of Deportivo
stories.summary: FC Barcelona confirmed on Thursday that Alejandro Balde has suffered a mild sprain to his right ankle. He left the pitch in the 65th minute against Sabah after assisting Adeyemi. The club has not ruled him out of Sunday’s trip to Deportivo de La Coruña at Riazor. Availability will depend on how he recovers over the next 48 hours.
stories.body: The official medical report was published on Thursday afternoon after tests at the Ciutat Esportiva. Balde started at left-back for the first time this season in Baku and delivered the cross for Adeyemi’s goal on 55 minutes. He felt discomfort on a shot shortly afterwards and was replaced by João Cancelo. SPORT and Mundo Deportivo both reported the sprain as mild and listed him as a doubt for the weekend rather than a certain absence. The next La Liga match is Sunday 29 November at 16:15. Barça sit top of the table on 36 points. A short recovery window remains before the squad travels to Galicia.

tweets.name: FC Barcelona
tweets.text: MEDICAL REPORT First-team player Alejandro Balde has suffered a mild sprain to his right ankle. He has not been ruled out of Sunday's match against RC Deportivo.

stories.headline: Barça will not appeal Fermín’s two-match ban
stories.summary: The club has decided not to take Fermín López’s two-match suspension to the Appeals Committee. He was sent off from the bench against Villarreal after protesting to the fourth official. The ban means he misses Sunday at Deportivo and Wednesday’s home match against Atlético Madrid. Fermín has nine goals and seven assists this season.
stories.body: Mundo Deportivo and SPORT reported on Thursday that Barcelona’s legal department reviewed the Disciplinary Committee decision and chose not to appeal. The referee’s report recorded that Fermín left the bench, approached the fourth official and repeated the phrase “No me jodas”. The committee applied Article 127 of the Disciplinary Code, the minimum sanction of two matches. The club had submitted written allegations seeking to overturn the red card or reduce the ban to one game; both were rejected. Fermín completed 90 minutes in Baku before the domestic ban takes effect. The Atlético fixture on 2 December at Spotify Camp Nou is the more significant absence for Hansi Flick.

tweets.name: Mundo Deportivo
tweets.text: El Barça no recurrirá la sanción de Fermín. El centrocampista se perderá los partidos ante el Dépor y el Atlético de Madrid.

stories.headline: Gordon named Champions League Player of the Week after Baku brace
stories.summary: Anthony Gordon has been named UEFA Champions League Player of the Week after scoring twice in the 4-1 win at Sabah. The England international opened the scoring in the 31st minute and added a second in the 51st. He finished ahead of Kylian Mbappé in the public vote. It was his first brace for the club.
stories.body: Gordon received the match MVP from captain Pedri after the game in Baku. The two goals take him to three in five Champions League appearances this season and six away goals in Azerbaijan across his career. Four of those came for Newcastle against Qarabağ last season. Opta recorded that no English player had previously scored six Champions League away goals in a single country. Adeyemi and Gabriel Jesus also scored as Flick rotated heavily, with Lamine Yamal remaining in Barcelona. Gordon has five goals and five assists in 17 appearances since joining from Newcastle in the summer.

tweets.name: FC Barcelona
tweets.text: The captain presents the award. Gordon takes home the MVP.

stories.headline: Àlex Campos makes his first-team debut in Baku
stories.summary: Àlex Campos came on for Frenkie de Jong in the 64th minute of the 4-1 win at Sabah and made his senior debut for the club. The young centre-back from Aitona had been with the first-team group in recent weeks. He became the latest La Masia product to feature under Hansi Flick in a European match.
stories.body: Campos replaced De Jong at centre-back with the score already 4-1. He had trained with the senior side in Baku and was named in the travelling squad. The club confirmed the debut on Wednesday night. Campos is one of several academy players who have been given minutes this season amid defensive injuries. Eric García, Andreas Christensen and Xavi Espart have all missed time, forcing De Jong into the centre-back role on several occasions. The appearance in Azerbaijan was Campos’s first competitive minutes at first-team level.

stories.headline: De Jong again fills in at centre-back as Barça manage the game
stories.summary: Frenkie de Jong started at centre-back for another match in Baku and helped keep Sabah quiet after the opening exchanges. He was replaced by Àlex Campos in the 64th minute. MARCA described the role as no longer an experiment after several appearances in the position this season.
stories.body: With Andreas Christensen ruled out and Pau Cubarsí managed carefully, De Jong has filled in across the back line when required. He partnered Gerard Martín in Baku with Jules Koundé and Balde outside them. Sabah scored once through Joy-Lance Mickels in the 63rd minute, but Barça had already built a three-goal lead. De Jong’s availability has given Flick flexibility while the specialist centre-backs recover. The next test comes at Riazor on Sunday, where the same options remain limited.

stories.headline: Squad returns with recovery planned before Sunday at Deportivo
stories.summary: The squad is back in Barcelona after the longest European trip in the club’s history. Flick had already indicated there would be no training on Thursday to aid recovery from the journey to Azerbaijan. The next session is expected on Friday ahead of the trip to Riazor.
stories.body: Barça sit top of La Liga on 36 points after the 3-2 win over Villarreal. Lamine Yamal stayed in Barcelona with mild right-ankle discomfort and is expected to be available for Deportivo. Raphinha and others received managed minutes or rest in Baku. The Champions League win moves the side to 12 points from five league-phase matches. The next domestic fixture is Sunday 29 November at 16:15 at Riazor, followed by Atlético Madrid at home on Wednesday.

stories.headline: Aubameyang says he is pain-free and ready for Barça at Riazor
stories.summary: Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang has told local media he is training without pain for the first time since his return from injury and feels fully fit. The Deportivo striker highlighted Pedri as the Barça player who impresses him most ahead of Sunday’s match at Riazor.
stories.body: Aubameyang spoke to Galician media on Thursday after recovering from a minor car incident on the way to training. He said the team will have to work harder than in their previous meeting with Barça and that he likes facing sides that play a high line. Deportivo sit in the lower half of the table. Barça travel to Riazor on Sunday as league leaders. Aubameyang had a short spell at the club earlier in his career and returns to face several former teammates.

stories.headline: Barça on 12 points after five league-phase matches
stories.summary: The 4-1 win at Sabah takes Hansi Flick’s side to 12 points from five Champions League league-phase matches. They sit inside the top eight with Manchester City, Sporting and Como still to come. Real Madrid lead the table with a perfect record.
stories.body: Barça have won four of their five matches in the new format, the only defeat coming at PSG. The result in Baku was secured with a heavily rotated side that still scored four goals. Spanish clubs as a group had a strong night, with Betis also inside the top eight and Atlético and Villarreal positioned for the play-off round. The next Champions League fixture is at home against Manchester City in December.
